scripts.start: cd packages/backend && bun run prisma generate && bun x prisma db push --skip-generate && bun src/index.ts
scripts.start:backend: cd packages/backend && bun run prisma generate && bun x prisma db push --skip-generate && bun src/index.ts
scripts.build: cd packages/backend && bun run prisma generate && cd ../../packages/frontend && bun run build
scripts.db:migrate: cd packages/backend && bun run prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:generate: cd packages/backend && bun run prisma generate
scripts.db:push: cd packages/backend && bun run prisma db push
scripts.dev:tunnel: concurrently "bun run dev:backend" "bun run dev:frontend" "cloudflared tunnel --url http://localhost:5173"
scripts.docker:up: docker compose build && docker compose up -d --remove-orphans
scripts.docker:up:sudo: sudo docker compose build && sudo docker compose up -d --remove-orphans
scripts.docker:up:frontend: docker compose build frontend && docker compose up -d --no-deps --remove-orphans frontend
scripts.docker:up:frontend:sudo: sudo docker compose build frontend && sudo docker compose up -d --no-deps --remove-orphans frontend
scripts.docker:up:backend: docker compose build backend && docker compose up -d --no-deps --remove-orphans backend
scripts.docker:up:backend:sudo: sudo docker compose build backend && sudo docker compose up -d --no-deps --remove-orphans backend
scripts.docker:seed: docker compose exec -e FORCE_SEED=true backend bun run prisma/seed.ts
scripts.docker:seed:sudo: sudo docker compose exec -e FORCE_SEED=true backend bun run prisma/seed.ts
